procedure_text: 向2L三口烧瓶加入的2‑氯‑3‑(2 ,2 ,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯231 .9g，1 ,2‑二氯乙烷1L，15℃搅拌。缓慢加入氯化亚砜237 .9g。常温反应0.5h，升温至75℃，保温3h。中控检测原料含量≤0.2％，在‑0.098mP下减压脱溶至85℃，脱去溶剂以及过量的氯化亚砜。
procedure_summary: The benzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane are charged into a three-necked flask and stirred cold, thionyl chloride is added slowly, the mixture is held at room temperature and then warmed and held until an in-process check on residual starting material passes, and the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride are distilled off under reduced pressure.
notes:
Chinese step marker: none. The step is the opening of [0053], up to and including the strip of the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride. Reactor: a 2 L three-necked flask; the volume is here because no numeric field holds it. 

CONTRADICTION 1, recorded and not resolved, and the reason this record carries a flag. The paragraph names the charged material as the benzoyl chloride and then adds thionyl chloride to it, holds it hot, checks residual starting material and strips the excess, which is the operation one performs on the benzoic acid. Reading A: the charged material is really the benzoic acid, misnamed by one Chinese character, and this step is the acid-to-acid-chloride conversion. Reading B: the charged material is the acyl chloride as printed and the whole thionyl chloride stage is redundant. The document does not choose and neither does this record: per prompt rule 5c the structured fields keep what the prose of this step says, so the reactant identifier is the acyl chloride as named, and the same identifier appears once as reactant and once as product because under BOTH readings the product of the step is that acyl chloride. That duplication is the finding, not an error. The same contradiction is carried by Synthesis Scheme_Step 1 for the unquantified version of this procedure, so it recurs in the document and is the patent's own, not a transcription slip in either section. The arithmetic bears on it and is in the provenance arithmetic_check: the printed thionyl chloride mass is a routine threefold excess against the acid and a wholly redundant charge against the acyl chloride. That is evidence, and it is deliberately not used here to decide which reading is right. 

FLAG CHOICE. The closed validation-flag list has no value for a stoichiometric charge that its own substrate cannot consume, and none for a contradiction internal to the prose. mass_balance_implausible is used for it, and this note says so explicitly: it is NOT being raised because a product mass exceeds theory, since this step states no product mass at all and the section's product-mass check does close. molar_mass_inconsistent was considered and rejected, because the section states no mass/mole pair at all. drawing_text_conflict was considered and rejected, because this section contains no drawing to conflict with. 

FLAG 2, the pressure unit, recorded and not fixed. The reduced pressure of the strip is printed -0.098mP, which is not a pressure unit; MPa is plainly meant. It is recorded exactly as printed, and only in workup.concentration_method, because distilling off under reduced pressure is a workup operation and sets concentration_method rather than reaction pressure (prompt rule 9). conditions.pressure is therefore not_specified. The 85 C is the endpoint of the distillation and not a reaction temperature. 

Conditions, as printed and not summed. Charged and stirred at 15 C, reacted 0.5 h at room temperature, warmed to 75 C, held 3 h. temperature carries the 75 C hold and time_h the 3 h hold, since one record holds one temperature and one time; the 15 C charge hold and the 0.5 h room-temperature stage are recorded here rather than added into a total the patent does not print. A stirrer is used but no type and no speed are given for this step, so conditions.stirring is left null. The in-process check names no analytical technique, so process_control.method stays null; which material the word for starting material denotes is subject to contradiction 1 above, and process_control.target_compound names the compound the prose names. 

Classification. nucleophilic_substitution because chloride replaces hydroxyl at the carboxyl carbon. acylation and halogenation are both defensible for the same transformation, which is why reaction_class_confidence is medium; the value follows this run's shared class table, and the reference run CN104292137A never annotates this step alone, so there is no precedent to follow. The transformation tag is chlorination, matching Synthesis Scheme_Step 1. 

THIONYL CHLORIDE IS DELIBERATELY NOT IN reactant_names, and this is the judgement call on this record. It is a genuine chemical participant, not a spectator: it is consumed and it is the source of the chlorine that ends up in the product, so an argument for listing it exists and is stronger than for any solvent. It is left out because the shared canonical identifier table fixes its role as reagent, and the flattened list is defined here by the role field, so listing it would make reactant_names disagree with the compounds[] entry it is supposed to summarise. Its full charge, its role and its addition profile are all still on the record. The same test removes 1,2-dichloroethane, which is only the solvent.

procedure_text: 环磺酮产品中加入40％含水甲醇，升温至60℃后加入5g活性炭保温1h，热过滤，搅拌转速调整为280转/h，控温滴加10％盐酸水溶液调节PH为2重结晶后降温析晶得淡黄色固体，烘干得262.1g环磺酮，含量95％。
procedure_summary: The crude product is dissolved in aqueous methanol and warmed, held with activated carbon and filtered hot. The stirring speed is adjusted, aqueous hydrochloric acid is added dropwise under temperature control to the target pH, and the solution is cooled so that the purified product crystallises out as a pale yellow solid, which is dried.
notes:
Chinese step marker: none. The step runs from the charge of aqueous methanol onto the crude product to the drying of the pale yellow solid, and it is the invention: it is the purification the claims and the summary describe generically and the batch tables of Examples 1 to 5 run on small samples, appended here to the synthesis at full scale. 

NON-SYNTHETIC. non_synthetic is true on this record and on neither of the other two: dissolving, treating with carbon, filtering, acidifying, cooling and crystallising break and make no bond in the tembotrione. reaction_class is recrystallisation, which is the one class in the closed list that describes an isolation rather than a transformation, and it is taken from this run's shared class table for a whole purification operation annotated as one record. mechanism_type is not_determinable because a crystallisation has no mechanism in the sense the enum means. The carbon treatment and the hot filtration are not split out as their own records: they have no charge of their own and no workup of their own, and the shared table annotates the whole dissolve-carbon-filter-acidify-cool-filter sequence as one recrystallisation. 

FLAG 3, the stirring speed against the patent's own claim, recorded and not fixed, and the reason this record's notes must be read even though its validation_flags are empty. The speed here is printed as 280 revolutions per hour. Claim 3, and [0025] with it, require the stirring speed of this step to be 150 to 200 revolutions, printed with no per-time base at all. So the document's only worked example of the invention falls outside the range its own dependent claim recites, and the two figures are not even in the same unit. Neither was adjusted, neither was converted, and conditions.stirring.rpm is left null on both grounds: the printed figure is per hour where the field expects per minute, and the claim's figure has no base. The printed phrase is here, which is the only place the schema allows it. 

WHY validation_flags IS EMPTY, said plainly so that empty is not read as clean. The closed list has no value for an example that falls outside its own claim, and no value for a unit that is not a unit. Both findings are recorded here and in the provenance arithmetic_check instead, and is_complete true on this record means only that the fifteen enumerated checks pass, not that the step is free of defects. The enumerated checks do pass: the record has a reactant and a product, it has conditions, its identifiers are A1's, and its arithmetic closes. 

CONCENTRATION, CORRECTED AFTER AN INDEPENDENT AUDIT, AND THE READING IT REPLACES. The printed phrase is 40% water-containing methanol, and the 40% is the WATER content, not the methanol content: [0018] states that the water content of the aqueous solution is 20 to 40 per cent, and claim 1 repeats it. concentration.reagent is therefore water, with the value and unit unchanged and the printed phrase carried in text. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS RECORD HAD IT THE OTHER WAY ROUND, naming methanol as the reagent, which would have described a medium that is 40% methanol and 60% water, the inverse of what the patent specifies and outside the claimed range. The thirteen batch records of Examples 2 to 5 assign the same phrase to water, so this now agrees with them. The 10% aqueous hydrochloric acid is the other stated concentration in this step and the schema has a single concentration object, so it is recorded on the hydrochloric acid's addition_profile, in purification and here, rather than displacing the methanol figure. 

Conditions. Warmed to 60 C and held 1 h with the carbon; temperature and time_h carry that hold, because it is the only temperature and the only period this step states. The cooling that crystallises the product is stated with no temperature and no method, so cooling_method is null and the operation is in workup.steps instead; nothing was invented for it. The acid is added dropwise, which is captured in its addition_profile and not in time_h. ph_value is 2.0 and workup.ph_target is 2.0: this example prints the pH as a value reached, not as the one-sided bound the claims print, which is why a number appears here where Claims_Step 3 leaves it null. reactor_type is null: the paragraph names no vessel for the purification and the flask of Steps 1 and 2 is not restated.

What the printed masses do imply is in the provenance arithmetic_check, where a computed number is allowed to live.

The reaction schema has no NMR field, so nothing is written into product_ms_mz or product_ms_type, which are for mass spectrometry; the datum is carried verbatim on the A1 tembotrione compound record and both paragraphs are quoted and cited in this record's provenance. analytics:nmr is tagged here so that a consumer reading only the reactions artifact can see that the step's product was characterised.
